mongo-db-atlas-cluster.connectionString: Connection string (URL) that allows connecting to the cluster.

upstash-redis.password: Autogenerated password that can be used to authenticate towards the database.
upstash-redis.restToken: Rest token which can be used when reading/writing from/to the database using the REST API
upstash-redis.readOnlyRestToken: Rest token which can be used only for reading from the database using the REST API
upstash-redis.restUrl: Rest URL which can be used when communicating with the database using the REST API
upstash-redis.redisUrl: Standard redis url (including password) which can be used for connecting using cli.

batch-job.stateMachineArn: Arn of the state machine controlling the execution flow of the batch job
batch-job.logGroupArn: Arn of the log group aggregating logs from the batch job

function.logGroupArn: Arn of the log group aggregating logs from the function

private-service.address: service host:port pair accessible only to other resources of stack(web-services, multi-container-workloads)

web-service.customDomains: Comma-separated list of custom domain names assigned to the Web Service (only available if you use custom domain names)
web-service.customDomainUrls: Comma-separated list of custom domain name URLs (only available if you use custom domain names)
web-service.cdnDomain: Default domain of the CDN distribution (only available if you DO NOT configure custom domain names for the CDN).
web-service.cdnUrl: Default url of the CDN distribution (only available if you DO NOT configure custom domain names for the CDN).
web-service.cdnCustomDomains: Comma-separated list of custom domain names assigned to the CDN (only available if you configure custom domain names for the CDN).
web-service.cdnCustomDomainUrls: Comma-separated list of custom domain name URLs of the CDN (only available if you configure custom domain names for the CDN).

dynamo-db-table.name: AWS (physical) name of the table
dynamo-db-table.streamArn: Arn of DynamoDb stream (available only if streamType is configured)

redis-cluster.host: In case of NON-sharded cluster(default), this is a hostname of the primary instance that can be used for both reads and writes. In case of sharded cluster, this is cluster's configuration endpoint that can be used for all operations.
redis-cluster.readerHost: Hostname (address) that can be used for reads only. (only available for NON-sharded clusters). If you use multiple replicas, it is advised to use readerHost for read operations to offload the primary host. ReaderHost automatically balances requests between available read replicas.
redis-cluster.sharding: Indicates whether cluster is sharded. Available values: enabled or disabled.

relational-database.connectionString: Fully-formed connection string that can be used to access the primary instance. For aurora databases, this is connectionString to cluster endpoint, which can be used for both reads and writes. Includes host, port, username, password and dbName.
relational-database.jdbcConnectionString: Fully-formed connection string in JDBC form that can be used to access the primary instance. Includes host, port, username, password and dbName.
relational-database.host: Hostname (address) of the primary instance that can be used for both reads and writes. For aurora databases, this is hostname of a cluster endpoint, which can be used for both reads and writes.
relational-database.dbName: Name of the automatically created database (can be configured using the dbName property).
relational-database.readerHost: Hostname (address) used for reads only. (only available for aurora-postgresql and aurora-mysql engines). If you have multiple instances, it is advised to use readerHost for reads to offload the primary (read/write) host. ReaderHost automatically balances requests between available instances. Connections are auto-balanced among available reader hosts.
relational-database.readerConnectionString: Same as connectionString but targets readerHosts (only available for aurora-postgresql and aurora-mysql engines). Connections are auto-balanced among available reader hosts.
relational-database.readerJdbcConnectionString: Same as readerConnectionString but in JDBC format (only available for aurora-postgresql and aurora-mysql engines).
relational-database.readReplicaHosts: Comma-separated list of read replica hostnames (only available if read replicas are configured). Read replicas can only be used for read operations.
relational-database.readReplicaConnectionStrings: Comma-separated list of connection strings (URLs) used to connect to read replicas (only available when read replicas are configured). Read replicas can only be used for read operations.
relational-database.readReplicaJdbcConnectionStrings: Same as readReplicaConnectionStrings but in JDBC format (only available when read replicas are configured).

application-load-balancer.customDomains: Comma-separated list of custom domain names assigned to the Load balancer (only available if you use custom domain names)
application-load-balancer.cdnDomain: Default domain of the CDN distribution (only available if you DO NOT configure custom domain names for the CDN).
application-load-balancer.cdnUrl: Default url of the CDN distribution (only available if you DO NOT configure custom domain names for the CDN).
application-load-balancer.cdnCustomDomains: Comma-separated list of custom domain names assigned to the CDN (only available if you configure custom domain names for the CDN).
application-load-balancer.cdnCustomDomainUrls: Comma-separated list of custom domain name URLs of the CDN (only available if you configure custom domain names for the CDN).

bucket.name: AWS (physical) name of the bucket
bucket.cdnDomain: Default domain of the CDN distribution (only available if you DO NOT configure custom domain names for the CDN).
bucket.cdnUrl: Default url of the CDN distribution (only available if you DO NOT configure custom domain names for the CDN).
bucket.cdnCustomDomains: Comma-separated list of custom domain names assigned to the CDN (only available if you configure custom domain names for the CDN).
bucket.cdnCustomDomainUrls: Comma-separated list of custom domain name URLs of the CDN (only available if you configure custom domain names for the CDN).

event-bus.archiveArn: Arn of the event bus archive (available only if the archivation is enabled)

hosting-bucket.name: AWS (physical) name of the bucket
hosting-bucket.cdnDomain: Default domain of the CDN distribution (only available if you DO NOT configure custom domain names for the CDN).
hosting-bucket.cdnUrl: Default url of the CDN distribution (only available if you DO NOT configure custom domain names for the CDN).
hosting-bucket.cdnCustomDomains: Comma-separated list of custom domain names assigned to the CDN (only available if you configure custom domain names for the CDN).
hosting-bucket.cdnCustomDomainUrls: Comma-separated list of custom domain name URLs of the CDN (only available if you configure custom domain names for the CDN).

http-api-gateway.customDomains: Comma-separated list of custom domain names assigned to the HTTP Api Gateway (only available if you use custom domain names)
http-api-gateway.customDomainUrls: Comma-separated list of custom domain name URLs (only available if you use custom domain names)
http-api-gateway.customDomainUrl: URL of the first custom domain name connected to this resource (only available if you use custom domain names)
http-api-gateway.cdnDomain: Default domain of the CDN distribution (only available if you DO NOT configure custom domain names for the CDN).
http-api-gateway.cdnUrl: Default url of the CDN distribution (only available if you DO NOT configure custom domain names for the CDN).
http-api-gateway.cdnCustomDomains: Comma-separated list of custom domain names assigned to the CDN (only available if you configure custom domain names for the CDN).
http-api-gateway.cdnCustomDomainUrls: Comma-separated list of custom domain name URLs of the CDN (only available if you configure custom domain names for the CDN).

network-load-balancer.customDomains: Comma-separated list of custom domain names assigned to the Load balancer (only available if you use custom domain names)
